capabilities.name: View a calendar month by month
capabilities.description: Open a month grid of calendar entries (attendance, absence, supplement and, in Employee, roster shifts and special days) and move between months with arrows, swipes or a month/year picker. The Manager

capabilities.name: Browse the calendar as a scrolling list
capabilities.description: Scroll a chronological list of calendar entries that loads more entries while scrolling. In Employee the list also lets you jump to a date and open an item.

capabilities.name: Switch between list and month view of the calendar
capabilities.description: Switch the calendar between a list/agenda view and a month grid. The app remembers the chosen view.

capabilities.name: See the details of a calendar day
capabilities.description: Tap a day to open a sheet listing that day's entries with time or full-day label, title and status. In Employee the sheet also shows the special day and the scheduled roster hours, and entries can be

capabilities.name: Customize what the calendar shows
capabilities.description: Hide weekends, show week numbers, filter entry types and choose icon or text style for events. The choices are saved across sessions.

capabilities.name: Start a time or absence registration from the calendar
capabilities.description: From the calendar list or a day detail, start registering new time or absence for yourself.

capabilities.name: Sync team birthdays and work anniversaries to my calendar
capabilities.description: A manager with HRM access turns calendar sync on or off. When sync is on, the app creates 'Manager App - Birthdays' and 'Manager App - Anniversaries' device calendars. Each employee gets a yearly all-

capabilities.name: See how many team members are absent today
capabilities.description: On the Start screen, the manager sees how many managed employees are absent today. The count comes from the month's calendar feed for all managed employees. If the feed fails, the signal is not shown.

capabilities.name: View an employee's absence balances
capabilities.description: A manager sees one employee's absence balances: total vacation balance, sick-child days for the current year and self-certified sickness over the last 12 months. A balance hook combines them for displ

capabilities.name: See my time and absence balances for a month
capabilities.description: From the calendar toolbar, an employee opens a summary of time and absence balances for the month on screen. They can expand a balance group for details and switch control options, which the app remem

capabilities.name: See my vacation balances on the start page
capabilities.description: An employee sees their combined vacation and leave balances as cards on the start page.

capabilities.name: Register an absence or time event
capabilities.description: The employee picks a day, a dragged range or the add button in the calendar, chooses an absence or time type from grouped calendar templates, fills the dynamic form (dates, times, hours or percent, co

capabilities.name: Pick cost-unit dimension values for a registration
capabilities.description: While registering or editing an absence, the employee picks dimension (cost unit) values from a paged, searchable list. Recently used values appear first.

capabilities.name: View details of a registered absence
capabilities.description: The employee opens a registered absence to see its type, fields, comment and approval status.

capabilities.name: Edit a registered absence
capabilities.description: From the absence detail, the employee edits a registered absence, including its type, and saves it through the entry's update link. The employee confirms a future-registration warning when the server

capabilities.name: Delete a registered absence
capabilities.description: From the absence detail or editor, the employee deletes a registered absence after a confirmation prompt, using the entry's delete link.

capabilities.name: See upcoming and ongoing vacation and parental leave on the start page
capabilities.description: The start page shows cards for declined, upcoming, ongoing and approved vacations and for parental leave, from one week ago to one month ahead.

capabilities.name: Check in and check out for the workday
capabilities.description: The employee checks in from the start page, which sends the current local time, sees the current check-in status, and later checks out. The checkout template is fetched to register the worked time.

capabilities.name: Edit or delete a check-in/check-out registration
capabilities.description: The employee corrects the fields of a check-in/check-out time registration, or deletes it, through the shared registration form or the calendar event editor.

capabilities.name: Confirm worked time up to a date
capabilities.description: The employee sends the timesheet for confirmation up to a date: a day from the calendar or day detail, the suggested date, or a chosen date from the type selector. The app loads the confirmation statu

capabilities.name: Register time or absence by chatting with the Employee Agent
capabilities.description: The employee opens the Employee Agent from the calendar toolbar. They type or dictate a sentence such as 'I was sick yesterday', or pick an example prompt. The agent predicts one or more absence or ti

capabilities.name: Confirm the time sheet through the Employee Agent
capabilities.description: When the agent reads the prompt as a time-confirmation request, it shows a confirm-time event. On confirm, the time sheet for that date is sent for approval.

capabilities.name: Ask the Employee Agent about leave balances
capabilities.description: The employee asks the agent about balances. The agent replies with the balance text that the prediction service returns.

capabilities.name: Edit a predicted registration before saving it
capabilities.description: From the agent's suggestion, the employee opens the registration form pre-filled with the prediction, for example to add a medical certificate for sickness. They adjust it and save, and the agent then

capabilities.name: View, edit or delete an absence created in the agent chat
capabilities.description: The employee taps an event the agent has just registered to open its detail. There they can edit or delete it, and a deletion shows in the chat.

capabilities.name: Learn how to use the Employee Agent and try example prompts
capabilities.description: The employee opens the info page to read about the agent and see example prompts from the server. Tapping an example puts it in the chat input.

capabilities.name: Send feedback about the Employee Agent
capabilities.description: From the Learn More page, the employee opens an external feedback form about the agent.

capabilities.name: Browse my expense claims by year and filter by status
capabilities.description: An employee sees their expense claims grouped by year, newest first. Claims without a date sit in their own section. Quick filters narrow the list by claim status.

capabilities.name: Browse my payslips by payment date, filtered by employer
capabilities.description: An employee pages through past and upcoming payslips in a calendar ordered by payment date. They can narrow the list to one or more employers (tenants).
